map.按智能体数量与消息频率估算全连接多智能体系统的通信开销，适用于多 Agent 架: Estimate communication overhead for a fully connected multi-agent system from agent count and message frequency, for multi-agent architecture design, bottleneck identification and cost evaluation.
map.消息总数 = n(n − 1) × 轮数；总流量 = 消息总数 × 单条大小: Total messages = n(n - 1) x rounds; total traffic = total messages x size per message
map.全连接广播模式下每个智能体每轮要向其余 n−1 个发消息，通信量随智能体数量呈平: In full-mesh broadcast mode each agent must message the other n-1 agents every round, so traffic grows quadratically with the number of agents, which is the main bottleneck to scaling multi-agent systems. Switching to hierarchical layouts or a shared blackboard cuts complexity to linear.
map.全连接拓扑下每轮消息数=C(n,2)=n(n−1)/2，随智能体数平方增长。: Under full connectivity, messages per round = C(n,2) = n(n-1)/2, growing with the square of the agent count.
map.开销=消息数×单消息体量(上下文/token)，是通信瓶颈与成本主因。: Overhead = message count x per-message size (context/tokens), and is the main driver of communication bottlenecks and cost.
map.可用分层/星型/广播拓扑削减边数，或用摘要压缩降低单消息体量。: Cut the number of edges with hierarchical/star/broadcast topologies, or compress messages into summaries to shrink each payload.
map.：n=10 个智能体全连接：每轮消息=10×9/2=45 条。若单条含 2k t: : n = 10 agents fully connected: messages per round = 10 x 9/2 = 45. If each carries 2k tokens, each round means about 90k tokens; at n = 20 messages reach 190, roughly 4x the overhead, growing very fast.
map.怎么降低多智能体通信成本？: How to cut multi-agent communication cost?
map.改全连接为星型/分层(中心协调)，减少边数；消息用摘要而非全文；并设定通信轮次上: Switch from full mesh to star/hierarchical (central coordinator) to cut edges; use summaries instead of full text; and cap communication rounds to avoid endless spinning conversations.
map.多数任务不需要。全连接让任意两体直连、信息同步快但成本高；若任务可分解，子团队+: Most tasks do not need it. Full connectivity lets any two agents connect directly with fast information sync but at high cost; if tasks decompose, sub-teams plus aggregation are more efficient and cost-effective.
